build_furthest_point_sample: build a python module to sample points from a point cloud using furthest point sampling on xyz coordinates
build_furthest_point_sample_with_dist: build a python module to sample points from a distance matrix using furthest point sampling
create_FurthestPointSampling_class: create a PyTorch autograd Function class that performs iterative furthest point sampling on 3D point coordinates
create_FurthestPointSamplingWithDist_cla: create a PyTorch autograd Function class that performs iterative furthest point sampling on a precomputed distance matrix
review_furthest_point_sample_api: review the furthest_point_sample and furthest_point_sample_with_dist APIs for point cloud downsampling in 3D detection
